intent: Change Odoo models, ORM, controllers and access behavior

intent: Change OWL, XML views, portal and QWeb reports

intent: Plan and execute approved data or addon migration

intent: Implement services, API contracts and background work
required_context: Existing entrypoints, authentication, request/response contracts

intent: Build or evaluate agents, retrieval and fallback
required_context: Existing gateway/RAG, user/tenant identity, dataset approval, budget

intent: Design or review MCP tools and adapters
required_context: Transport, negotiated protocol, identity, endpoint scope

intent: Review an authorized change or system for security
required_context: Target authorization, threat model, data classes, affected surfaces

intent: Choose and run relevant automated and functional checks
required_context: Changed behavior, runtime, test commands, isolated data

intent: Reproduce and fix a confirmed bug
required_context: Symptoms, logs with secrets removed, expected behavior, revision

intent: Analyze authorized applications into original requirements

intent: Prepare approved PiCloud or existing pipeline releases

intent: Maintain scoped product context and reusable evidence
required_context: Source revision, owner, classification, expiry/review date

intent: Measure delivery and model cost per accepted task
required_context: Representative baseline, accepted-task criteria, usage/time records
example: Measure the cost of fixing five bugs

intent: Orient an unfamiliar Odoo addon and trace impact
required_context: Authorized source root, relevant addon and revision

intent: Choose the smallest complete solution

example: Choose reuse for an approval button

intent: Draft discovery, fit-gap, synthetic demo and proposal scope

intent: Triage support and draft verified customer updates

intent: Write role- and version-specific operating guidance
required_context: Verified workflow, role, edition, branding and audience

intent: Profile and improve measured latency or resource use
required_context: Reproducible workload, authorized target, latency/query baseline
example: Reduce a slow stock report query

intent: Review and update skill candidates and trusted knowledge
required_context: Requested scope, pinned source, license, owner and evaluation

intent: Compare licensed AI products with original Primacy development
